task: Persist rubric components and evidence to D1, publish through an idempotent queue checkpoint, and consume the published rubric through frontend polling.
nonGoals: No collection or rubric expansion, live model/browser calls in CI, production changes, new service, quota change or 60-second model timeout change.
Keep frontend visual changes limited to the result adapter and pending-to-terminal behavior. Do not alter other PR branches.

outcomes.description: A local user-started audit records the expected component outcomes, including verified programmatic findings and unresolved reasons, before it publishes a report.
outcomes.evidence: Migration and SQLite/D1 queue-to-API tests with exact states and evidence joins.

outcomes.description: Finalization is recoverable across dispatch failures and duplicate delivery and does not re-run completed inference.
outcomes.evidence: Queue fault probes and independent continuation from a stored checkpoint.

outcomes.description: The frontend displays pending and terminal v3 results with 24 rows, component evidence and earned subtotals.
outcomes.evidence: Frontend contract and polling tests plus local browser verification.

process.description: Use Terra agents, separately committed acceptance plan, genuine fresh-agent exit test, independent review and PR CI.
process.evidence: Git history and recorded evaluation artifacts.

styleEfficiency.description: Reuse the existing queue, scoring, usage reservations, API envelope and poll flow.
styleEfficiency.evidence: Scoped diff, fault coverage and independent review.

exitTest.reason: The persisted result to queue publication handoff adds a new resumable boundary. A fresh agent must finish an interrupted local audit from only the saved checkpoint.
